verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਬਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਂਤ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ki(n)chat kaTaachh dhib dheh dhib dhirasaT hui dhib jot ko dhiaan dhib dhirasaTaa(n)t kai ||

en.bdb: With just a miniscule of clement look of Satguru, the body and looks of a disciple of the Guru become divine. He then starts seeing the presence of the Lord all around him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਗੰਮਿ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਕੋ ਮਤਾਂਤ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh bibek Tek pragaT hui gurmat anahadh ga(n)m unamanee ko mataa(n)t kai ||

en.bdb: By meditating on Gur Shabad (Guru's Word) and taking its refuge, Guru's precepts are revealed to him. When he reaches the state of listening to unstruck melody of the divine word, he enjoys the bliss of higher state of equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਨੀ ਕੈ ਉਪਜਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਨਿਜ ਕ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan karanee kai upajat prem ras gurmukh sukh prem nem nij kraa(n)t kai ||

en.bdb: Concentrating on the knowledge of the True Guru, listening to his counsel, practicing contemplation and living life according to His command, a feeling of love grows and blossoms. And in living this life of love, a Guru-conscious person realises the radiance of his self by the divine enlightenment.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਮਧੁਪ ਗਤਿ  ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਮਧੁ ਪਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸ਼ਾਂਤਿ ਕੈ ॥੪੩॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal dhal sa(n)paT madhup gat  sahaj samaadh madh paan praan shaa(n)t kai ||43||

en.bdb: As the bumble bee attains the divine bliss by drinking the elixir and getting shut in the box-like petals of a lotus flower, similarly in order to provide spiritual peace to his life, a true seeker enjoins the lotus-like feet of Guru and drinks deep by contemplating on Naam. (43)
